title: Discussing the next step in your career
objectives: Give specific evidence of increased responsibility
Respond to feedback and propose a growth opportunity
Agree to a development action and a check-in

courseTemplate.setting: The employee led a migration project and mentored two people. The manager wants more cross-team visibility.

roles.learner: An employee interested in a promotion

courseTemplate.openingLine: You said you're interested in stepping up. What have you taken on this year?

targetPatterns.pattern: I led the migration project and mentored two newer team members.
targetPatterns.example: I led the migration project and mentored two newer team members.

targetPatterns.pattern: Could I lead the next quarterly review presentation so other teams can see the project?
targetPatterns.example: Could I lead the next quarterly review presentation so other teams can see the project?

targetPatterns.pattern: Let's add it to my development plan and review my progress next month.
targetPatterns.example: Let's add it to my development plan and review my progress next month.

targetPatterns.pattern: I'd like to discuss my career path here.
targetPatterns.example: I'd like to discuss my career path here.
targetPatterns.translation: 我想聊聊我在这里的职业发展路径。

targetPatterns.pattern: What would it take to get to the senior level?
targetPatterns.example: What would it take to get to the senior level?
targetPatterns.translation: 升到高级岗位需要什么条件？

targetPatterns.pattern: I've taken on more responsibility this year.
targetPatterns.example: I've taken on more responsibility this year.
targetPatterns.translation: 今年我承担了更多职责。

targetPatterns.pattern: Could you be my mentor for the next six months?
targetPatterns.example: Could you be my mentor for the next six months?
targetPatterns.translation: 未来半年您能做我的导师吗？

targetPatterns.pattern: I'm interested in rotating to the growth team.
targetPatterns.example: I'm interested in rotating to the growth team.
targetPatterns.translation: 我有意轮岗到增长团队。

targetPatterns.pattern: Where do you see gaps in my skill set?
targetPatterns.example: Where do you see gaps in my skill set?
targetPatterns.translation: 您觉得我的技能有哪些短板？

targetPatterns.pattern: I'd like to lead the next project end to end.
targetPatterns.example: I'd like to lead the next project end to end.
targetPatterns.translation: 我想端到端负责下一个项目。

targetPatterns.pattern: Can we set concrete goals for this review cycle?
targetPatterns.example: Can we set concrete goals for this review cycle?
targetPatterns.translation: 这个考核周期能定些具体目标吗？

stages.title: Give specific evidence of increased responsibility
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “You said you're interested in stepping up. What have you taken on this year?”
successCriteria: The learner can give specific evidence of increased responsibility in their own words.
hints: You can start with “I led the migration …”

stages.title: Respond to feedback and propose a growth opportunity
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “That's good progress. I'd like other teams to see more of your work.”
successCriteria: The learner can respond to feedback and propose a growth opportunity in their own words.
hints: You can start with “Could I lead the …”

stages.title: Agree to a development action and a check-in
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “That's a good opportunity. How should we follow up?”
successCriteria: The learner can agree to a development action and a check-in in their own words.
hints: You can start with “Let's add it to …”

languageNotes: 谈晋升要讲「证据」（项目、数据、影响），不是讲苦劳；「带团队」lead a team，别用 "manage people" 表达还没做到的事。

modelDialogue.text: You said you're interested in stepping up. What have you taken on this year?
I led the migration project and mentored two newer team members.
That's good progress. I'd like other teams to see more of your work.
Could I lead the next quarterly review presentation so other teams can see the project?
That's a good opportunity. How should we follow up?
Let's add it to my development plan and review my progress next month.
